summary: Complete testing of Invoice Adjustments (Discounts & Additions) feature. Backend: 13/13 tests passed. Frontend: All UI elements verified including Discounts & Additions section, Add Discount/Add Fee buttons, category dropdowns, calculation types, and totals display.

GET /api/invoice/adjustment-categories.details: Returns all categories: discounts (contract_discount, early_payment, volume_discount, promotional, custom), additions (shipping, service_fee, table_tax, insurance, handling, custom), calculation_types (percentage, fixed), base_options (before_tax, after_tax)

POST /api/invoice/ (percentage discount.details: 5% discount on 1000 EGP = 50 EGP, Grand Total = 1090 EGP

POST /api/invoice/ (fixed discount).details: 100 EGP fixed discount, Grand Total = 1040 EGP

POST /api/invoice/ (fixed addition - shi.details: 75 EGP shipping fee, Grand Total = 1215 EGP

POST /api/invoice/ (percentage addition.details: 10% service fee = 100 EGP, Grand Total = 1240 EGP

POST /api/invoice/ (multiple adjustments.details: 5% discount (50 EGP) + 50 EGP shipping = Grand Total 1140 EGP

POST /api/invoice/ (multiple discounts).details: 5% + 30 EGP fixed = 80 EGP total discount, Grand Total = 1060 EGP

POST /api/invoice/ (discount after tax).details: 5% after tax on 1140 = 57 EGP, Grand Total = 1083 EGP

All discount categories.details: contract_discount, early_payment, volume_discount, promotional, custom all work

All addition categories.details: shipping, service_fee, table_tax, insurance, handling, custom all work

GET /api/invoice/{id} (with adjustments).details: Invoice retrieval includes adjustment details and calculated amounts

POST /api/invoice/ (without adjustments).details: Invoice creation without adjustments still works correctly

invoices_page_load.details: Electronic Invoices page loads with tabs, stats cards, and invoice table

create_invoice_modal.details: Modal opens with Date, Due Date, Payment Terms, Customer, Currency fields

discounts_additions_section.details: Section displays with 'Discounts & Additions' header and Add Discount/Add Fee buttons

add_discount_button.details: Red 'Add Discount' button adds discount row with category dropdown, calculation type, value input, apply on dropdown

add_fee_button.details: Green 'Add Fee' button adds addition row with same configuration options

discount_categories_dropdown.details: Shows Contract Discount, Early Payment, Volume Discount, Promotional, Custom Discount options

addition_categories_dropdown.details: Shows Shipping Fee, Service Fee, Table Tax, Insurance, Handling Fee, Custom Addition options

calculation_type_dropdown.details: Shows Percentage % and Fixed Amount options

apply_on_dropdown.details: Shows Before Tax and After Tax options

adjustment_total_display.details: Discount shows negative value in red (-50), Addition shows positive value in green (+0)

totals_section_with_adjustments.details: Shows Subtotal, Discount % (Lines), Tax (VAT), Total Discounts (when present), Total Additions (when present), Grand Total

real_time_calculation.details: Totals update in real-time as adjustments are configured

seed_data_creation: Created multiple test invoices with various adjustment configurations (INV-2026-00004 through INV-2026-00017+)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Invoice Adjustments feature fully tested. Backend endpoint GET /api/invoice/adjustment-categories returns all categories. POST /api/invoice/ accepts adjustments array with adjustment_type (discount/addition), category, name, calculation_type (percentage/fixed), value, base (before_tax/after_tax). Frontend InvoicesPage.jsx has Discounts & Additions section in Create Invoice modal with Add Discount (red) and Add Fee (green) buttons. Totals section shows Total Discounts and Total Additions when present.
